page: Amazon Web Services r8ib.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. It features a 64-bit x86 Intel processor running at a base clock of 3.9 GHz. The instance allocates 64 dedicated vCPUs spanning 32 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled at two threads per core. System memory totals 512.0 GB, providing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU distribution (8.0 GB per core).

Hardware accelerators are not included on this instance, with a GPU count of zero. The instance also features no local storage, requiring all persistent data and system volumes to be provisioned via remote block storage. For network traffic, the r8ib.16xlarge provides a high baseline network throughput of 67 Gbps, facilitating rapid data movement across distributed nodes and storage endpoints.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the resource ratio favors memory-heavy computing over disk-dependent tasks. Because local storage is absent, total operational cost depends partly on external storage sizing and I/O requirements. The r8ib.16xlarge is architected for large in-memory databases, distributed caches, real-time stream processing, and big data analytical workloads that demand significant RAM capacity alongside high network bandwidth.
